description: This file defines a React functional component named RoleGate, which serves as a role-based access control wrapper for rendering child components conditionally based on user roles (teacher, student, or any). It manages loading states and permissions, redirecting unauthenticated users to login and restricting access for certain roles.

methods.name: RoleGate({ allow = "any", children })
methods.description: React component that conditionally renders children based on user role and authentication status, with loading and access restriction handling.
